title: 营销渠道转化与获客成本
context: 营销负责人希望评估不同渠道效率。
requirements: 2025年，按访问渠道归因；转化率=有有效订单的不同会话数/会话数；新客数只计历史首次线上有效订单；获客成本=渠道广告支出/新客数；净收入广告回报=净销售/广告支出；零分母NULL。
commonError: 广告支出不能直接连接订单明细求和；转化分母是会话不是客户。
executionSteps: 按渠道汇总转换与收入
mysqlSql: WITH s AS (SELECT source_id,COUNT(*) sessions FROM customer_sessions WHERE session_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY source_id), o AS (SELECT *,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY order_date,order_id) rn FROM v_order_net WHERE channel='online'), a AS (SELECT t.source_id,COUNT(DISTINCT o.session_id) converted,SUM(CASE WHEN rn=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) new_customers,SUM(net_cents) net FROM o JOIN customer_sessions t ON t.session_id=o.session_id WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY t.source_id), p AS (SELECT source_id,SUM(spend_cents) spend FROM marketing_campaigns WHERE month_key BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-12' GROUP BY source_id) SELECT t.source_id,s.sessions,COALESCE(a.converted,0) converted,ROUND(100.0*COALESCE(a.converted,0)/NULLIF(s.sessions,0),2) conversion_pct,COALESCE(a.new_customers,0) new_customers,p.spend spend_cents,ROUND(1.0*p.spend/NULLIF(a.new_customers,0),2) cac_cents,ROUND(1.0*a.net/NULLIF(p.spend,0),4) roas FROM traffic_sources t LEFT JOIN s ON s.source_id=t.source_id LEFT JOIN a ON a.source_id=t.source_id LEFT JOIN p ON p.source_id=t.source_id ORDER BY t.source_id
